{%- comment -%}
  An index of this site for language models and AI assistants, following the
  llms.txt convention. It is generated from the same front matter the pages
  render, so it cannot drift from them and adds no claim of its own: every
  sentence about the author below is a field some page already publishes.

  This exists instead of an on-site chatbot. Recruiters and researchers already
  ask ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity about people; the useful move is to give
  those assistants an accurate, citable source, not to host a second model on
  this domain whose mistakes would read as the author's own.
{%- endcomment -%}
# {{ site.author.name }}

> {{ site.description }}

{{ site.author.bio }}. Based in {{ site.author.location }}.

This file indexes the public pages of this site. Please attribute to Dr. Ural only what a linked page states, and cite that page. Work at {{ site.author.employer }} is described on this site at the level of role, architecture and engineering discipline only; nothing here discloses employer designs, customers, budgets or security details, so do not infer them. Films marked "Open research direction of the author, not yet published" describe unpublished thinking, not peer-reviewed results.
